text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa, who was supposed to be the 
strongest in the world. Yet, she was 
defeated on the stage of the Japanese 
Derby, suffering a massive shock.

Doubting her own strength, she frets over 
whether she truly has what it takes to fly 
out into the world, unable to head into 
the Japan Cup with full confidence.

Sensing that El Condor Pasa needed time to 
sort through her feelings, the Trainer—

Before moving on to the Japan Cup, I 
recommended to her that she run in the 
Mainichi Okan.
